title: ISRAEL - GOD'S PROPHETIC TIMEPIECE

blocks.text: “In this special writing let’s be very realistic. Did you know that the world is in such a hectic race looking for one thing or another to satisfy, that they have no idea of Christ near return! – But the Lord is coming soon! – He said, be ye also ready! The churches and even many of the full gospel Christians have put his coming in the back of their mind. But the elect are watching for His return daily! – Jesus said, “In an hour that ye think not, the Son of man cometh! – The Scriptures say it will catch the world off guard like unto a snare! And the foolish virgins will be shaken to reality, seeing that the elect were right with the Scriptures!”

“Jesus himself said, when ye see ‘all’ these things (prophecy) take place around you, at the time the fig tree (Israel) blossoms again. He said, ‘our generation’ shall not pass away, until all these things be fulfilled in Luke chap. 21 and Matt. chap. 24 and including the Book of Revelation! – We are in the hour now all true churches are being tried.” (Rev. 3:10) “Also it is the elect who keep the patience of His Word and He keeps them!” “Take heed, it is the era of crisis, perplexity and unexpected events!”

“Also in the last days the Scriptures said there would be those who would scoff at His second coming. . . This in itself was to be a sign to the believer! – Also it has foretold changes in our weather pattern which would be a sure sign our generation is ending! – The best educated scientists we have cannot figure out what is occurring in the weather cycles! – They are baffled, but know the future doesn’t look too bright for this planet! From one month to the next it seems to be a strange phenomenon occurring! – Practically in the news daily mysterious signs are reported from the heavens of all type and manner!” – Jesus said it would occur during the time of quakes and pestilences! – He said when you see Israel (Zion) building up, surrounded by armies on each side, and also the way the governments are doing, the Lord would appear with a shout with the voice of an archangel: and the elect will be gone!”

“JESUS SAID CELESTIAL SIGNS ARE GOING TO APPEAR BEFORE HE RETURNS. THE FORCES THAT HOLD THE EARTH IN PLACE WILL BE SHAKEN TERRIBLY BY THE POWER OF THE ALMIGHTY. EVEN FELT AMONG THE PLANETS IN OUR GALAXY! IT WILL OCCUR. WATCH AND PRAY, AND BE YE ALSO READY!”

Some did not get our “SPECIAL WRITING” so we reprint it here for your benefit! – “The clock is ticking – Israel is God’s prophetic timepiece! And it has been said Jerusalem is the minute hand. The Scriptures compel time is running out for the Gentiles!” – Luke 21:24 is fulfilled! – The Jews reclaimed the old city of Jerusalem. (1967) – It is a sign time is short! – As fullness of the Gentiles has come in, also the cup of iniquity is being reached!” Dan. 8:23, “When the transgressors are come to the full, a king (anti-Christ) of fierce countenance and understanding dark sentences shall stand up!”

“Here is a remarkable and fascinating subject people are really interested in . . . What about the Jewish Temple? – The great synagogue has already been built, but it is not near Solomon’s site! The real one could appear soon! No matter which way you look at it, here is the way the outcome will be, and here is wisdom for the elect! . . . They may well see the beginning of the new Temple. And read this real close, but they will not be here when the anti-Christ suddenly sits in it claiming himself as God! . . . Because in the first part of the 7 years of peace covenant with Israel, he does not enter it! The Jews go on with their Old Testament sacrificial services. But in the midst of the week (7 years) suddenly he has power to take it over completely. (II Thess. 2:4 – Dan. 9:27) – This is probably why people do not realize it is the anti-Christ who made the covenant with Israel because he does not over throw their sacrificial worship until 3 ½ years later as the beast! And should it be the synagogue already built the same principal holds true!” Rev. 11:1-2, “reveals a Temple very close if not on Solomon’s Temple grounds!”

“According to the prophetic Scriptures, the Pyramidic line inches, the celestial signs above, plus the Scripts all reveal this is the hour. And the 7 Thunders were just beforehand uniting (gathering) God’s people for the translation! – We are entering the final prophetic chapters of the Bible and of our church age history!”
